adversarial: A gate that passes on an unreadable log would be a silent hole — the gate script exits 2 on an unreadable log and never passes silently; duplicate FAIL lines report once.

Baseline stuffing is prevented by the shipped-empty pin (the baseline file exists with zero entries) plus the same-change reason rule in CI_GATES.md: every FAIL is new until a human records the exact line with a reason in the same change.

The advisory promotion trap is pinned in both directions: the wiring leg asserts the desktop step carries continue-on-error (as first built in P0-18, a desktop failure would have failed the job and silently promoted an advisory signal to a gate).
